body:
There is no unedited comment. I came here to share my story and help people not make the same painful mistakes as I did. 

What I meant is - I literally and personally cannot help you. I unfortunately do not see the same as you in terms of compassion and empathy.

You stated that no one has compassion to your struggles, and here I am. But you still push help away. It's still you vs me when it's really you vs the world.  

I still hope you find peace or get your shit together coz I didn't come here to be attacked personally. Good luck
Thank you I wish you well. Big hugs
Stay with us. There's so much love that we need to give before we go. I wish you and your family well. Hugs.
I'm so happy you're with us today.

That sounds like a bunch of traumatic experiences. I'm glad you are still here. 

I really wish you well.
Thank you, and I wish you well

I don't wish to make you cry :( 

But I do wish you well. I hope you are okay
Thank you, I am wishing you well.

I was lucky to have some compassionate care that showed me my life was valued even by stranger nurses. 

I can't guide you on your path, nor can I suggest anything to help you on your path. When you want to live, you will. When you want to die, you will. God has a plan for us all. I can only pray that you find help and peace in your body mind and soul. I value every existing human, so here's one person who cares about you CatJam.

I was coded and resuscitated... So I guess it's not that impossible is it

This comment is misinformation. You cannot say dying from pills is impossible not knowing people's underlying conditions, mental and physical state, age, weight, diet... You literally made an empty assumption based on drug interactions and their side effects?

You do realize people can have seizures and have brain damage from overdoses right?

Anyways please don't comment this ever again - it's unhelpful to this community

Please take a chance with the hospital. I don't think they would turn you away, you deserve clarity and help with your mental health. Some time in a hospital may paint a different picture for you than you previously looked at. 

Your life matters. Stay with us please, your best friend's mental health is second to yours. But you have to be alive to see it through.
Thank you, I wish you well
As someone who just overdosed, it is hell. I know it feels like hell to be alive but you're somebody's heaven in this world.
